name: Data@ccess Ponce secondary colocation site
notes: Official Data@ccess service page says it provides secure collocated rack space at its main San Juan site and secondary site in Ponce; power/capacity not disclosed.

name: Netwave Ponce Second Data Center Facilities (BRCS)
notes: Official Netwave network page lists Ponce as its second data center facilities (BRCS), alongside San Juan network operations/data center facilities and other network nodes; power/capacity not disclosed.

name: Seabase subsea AI compute/data-center pilot cluster candidate
notes: News is My Business/Aqui.PR coverage says Seabase is exploring Puerto Rico for modular subsea AI-compute systems near ports and that Ponce, San Juan, and the east coast are under consideration; not yet a confirmed Ponce deployment, so status is unknown.
